$comment: Known-flaky visual captures. Each entry is { taskId, expires, capture, legs, why }: the owning task, the last day it holds (at most 30 days out), the capture (the item path without its variant prefix and without .png, e.g. js-only/filters/tab-navigation-through-condition-components-2), the variants that flake (e.g. ["js/chromium-theme-main-dark"]), and one line on what flakes. At most 6 entries and 12 items (one per leg). A quarantined capture still renders, compares, and is listed in the comment, the nightly summary and the flake ledger; it only stops blocking, and only while it is a changed item. An expired entry blocks again AND fails Checks / tooling tests on every pull request until it is removed or renewed. Rules: visual-tests/AGENTS.md, Guardrails (G5).
